{{Quote|I am Jeek! I am a tier-six inventor of Research Corps Eight of the Imperial Science Bureau!|Jeek|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Research Corps Eight''' was a division in the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] twin brothers [[Jeek]] and [[Teek (Neimoidian)|Teek]] were both tier-six inventors in the Research Corps.
